test_policy.notes: Score optional since 2007 for SAT/ACT, including international applicants. Applicants to Computer Science or Engineering may be considered without scores if they meet the math requirements (four years of high school math including a course above Algebra II, grades of B or higher). If scores are submitted, official results must arrive before the first day of classes.

requirements.notes: Common App or Mason's own application are reviewed equally; $75 freshman fee, waivers available. Certified official, original transcripts and leaving/entrance exam results (certified English translation if needed). Personal statement (about 250 words) is optional but strongly encouraged; two recommendation letters (one counselor, one teacher) are suggested, not required. Resume only for applicants with enrollment gaps.

deadlines.label: Early Action (non-binding; international Honors College consideration)
deadlines.notes: Decision in mid-December. Early applicants get priority for the Honors College and merit scholarships. The page gives no year, so the current (fall 2027) cycle is assumed.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Decision in spring. Later applications are reviewed on a space-available basis.

deadlines.label: International final deadline for fall semester
deadlines.notes: Listed only for international freshman applicants; applications after Feb. 1 are space-available.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Waivers include four years at a George Mason-recognized accredited US secondary school with a C or better in each non-ESL college-prep English course; four years of non-ESL English with C/4 or better under IB or UK curricula (fall 2026 applicants onward); four years at a school in a listed waiver-eligible country where English is the primary language of instruction; six English Composition credits (C or better) from a recognized US institution; or a bachelor's or higher degree from a recognized US institution. Also accepted: SAT EBRW 500+, ACT English and Reading 20+ each, IB HL English A 6. Scores must be under two years old; TOEFL MyBest and Home Edition accepted; IELTS Indicator not accepted. Pathway: the Gateway Freshman International Direct program admits academically qualified applicants (high school GPA 2.9+) with English slightly lower (TOEFL iBT 70 / new 4.0 with 3.5 each skill, IELTS 6.0 with 5.5 each skill, PTE 53, Duolingo 100): one semester of English and transition courses (14-16 credits) with a direct-entry I-20, then progression to a degree; the Gateway page says its information applies to students starting spring 2027 and later.

english.notes: Tests taken before Jan. 21, 2026. College of Engineering and Computing applicants: 80 overall, no section minimum. TOEFL institution code 5827.
Tests taken on or after Jan. 21, 2026; the page does not name the 1-6 scale. Engineering and Computing applicants: 4.5, no section minimum.
Engineering and Computing applicants: 6.5, no section minimum. IELTS Indicator not accepted; One Skill Retake accepted.

aid.notes: Mason offers a limited number of merit-based scholarships to highly qualified international freshmen and transfers on F-1 visas; all admitted applicants are considered automatically (no separate application) through a holistic review in which GPA and test scores matter most. Awards renew for up to four years for freshmen. Amounts are not published. Non-US citizens are not eligible for federal aid; the page does not describe need-based institutional aid for international students.

majors.program: Computer Science and Engineering (College of Engineering and Computing)
majors.notes: Needs four years of high school math including a course above Algebra II, plus SAT Math 550 / ACT Math 24 or B (not B-) or higher in all math through Algebra II. Admitted students who do not qualify are placed in CEC Undeclared.

Direct-admission freshman applications get a second review by the School of Nursing admission committee; described as highly competitive. Students admitted to the university but not to the School become undeclared.

sat.note: George Mason's admissions pages do not print an SAT code; have the College Board send scores to George Mason University (Fairfax).

act.note: George Mason's admissions pages do not print an ACT code; look it up at act.org.

tier_notes.general: Large public research university; admits about 87% of applicants, with a wide score range, so an SAT ~1100 international applicant is a likely admit.
tier_notes.computer_science: Our estimate: large College of Engineering and Computing near Washington DC; no ranking cited.
